EXP-0032.title: Anatomical MRI Muscle Volumetry vs Dynamic Functional Recruitment
EXP-0032.source: Franke et al. (2020) Front. Bioeng. Biotechnol. 8:622, PMC7332772

mri_measured_parameters.sequence: 3D T1-weighted VIBE, isotropic 0.8 mm^3, 160 sagittal slices

flux_distortion_audit.finding: Anatomical MRI accurately measures V_anat (379.89 mL), but true submaximal active volume is restricted to 83.6 - 144.4 mL (nominal 120.6 mL). Substituting V_anat for V_active produces a 2.63- to 4.55-fold underestimation of local ATP demand flux.

EXP-0032.negative_result: Anatomical MRI alone cannot determine V_active without an independent, dynamic recruitment model.

EXP-0033.title: Absolute Phosphagen Quantification and Thermodynamic Scale: Enthalpy vs Free Energy

enthalpy_vs_gibbs_comparison.finding: Calorimetric enthalpy (Delta_H=21 kJ/mol) measures reaction heat release, while cross-bridge thermodynamic work capacity is governed by Delta_G (-54 kJ/mol). Confusing Delta_H and Delta_G causes an immediate 2.57-fold scaling discrepancy in metabolic power balance.

pcr_buffer_pool_capacity_bounds_J.finding: Combined concentration ([PCr] in [26.6, 38.9] mM), active volume (0.084 - 0.380 L), and thermodynamic potential (-50 to -64 kJ/mol) uncertainties generate an 8.50-fold ambiguity (111.2 J to 945.8 J) in static resting PCr buffer capacity.

EXP-0033.negative_result: Absolute phosphagen energy scale cannot be identified without simultaneously pinning [ATP]_ref, recruitment fraction, and thermodynamic potential Delta_G_ATP.

EXP-0034.title: Local Oxygen Baseline (M_loc) Bounding: Invasive A-V vs ASL vs NIRS

invasive_catheterization_gold_standard.finding: Direct femoral arterial-venous catheterization provides the sole absolute human anchor for resting skeletal muscle oxygen consumption: M_loc = 0.0064 +/- 0.0017 mmol ATP/L/s.

asl_mri_perfusion_evaluation.finding: ASL-MRI measures capillary perfusion without oxygen extraction; without independent venous oximetry, ASL leaves a 2.25-fold ambiguity in M_loc.

nirs_vot_evaluation.measured_quantity: Rate of tissue hemoglobin desaturation (dStO2/dt in %/s)
confounding_nuisance_parameters: Adipose tissue thickness (ATT) scattering attenuation (2 - 12 mm)
nirs_vot_evaluation.finding: Continuous-wave NIRS vascular occlusion testing yields a relative kinetics surrogate; uncalibrated optical pathlength and skinfold thickness induce a 6.67-fold ambiguity in molar ATP baseline flux.

EXP-0034.negative_result: Non-invasive ASL and NIRS cannot identify M_loc without invasive calibration phantoms or direct blood gas verification.

EXP-0035.title: Measurement Map Identifiability vs Ideal Channels

nullspace_resolution_audit.finding: In configuration P7, SVD rank is strictly 6/7 due to collinearity between eta_loc and dG_ATP. Introducing the independent 31P-MRS spectroscopic free-energy channel (y_spec = dG_ATP via Pi chemical shift and CK equilibrium) strictly eliminates the nullspace, restoring FULL RANK 7/7 with condition number kappa_eff = 15.39.

EXP-0035.negative_result: Ideal scalar channels (y = theta_j) in Cycle 7 masked real physical identifiability defects; physical MRI and NIRS channels alone do not break parameter symmetries without spectroscopic potential anchoring.

EXP-0036.title: Macro-Model Transferability Audit: D2 9D Quotient vs Local Parameters & TARGET-CPE45

scaling_discrepancy_audit.finding: Local gastrocnemius bioenergetics operate on 0.05 W basal and 3.89 W maximal oxidative scales, compared to 80 W basal and 1200 W maximal scales for whole-body exercise. Direct parameter substitution into D2 without whole-body recruitment scaling causes catastrophic dimensional failure (exhaustion at 20 W in <15 s).

d2_quotient_preservation.reason: The 9 effective quotient parameters of D2 (Cycle 5) reflect macroscopic whole-body work and recovery. Local single-muscle anchors cannot be transferred without whole-body anatomical recruitment maps.

target_cpe45_evaluation.reason: Isolated calf plantarflexion measurements provide zero empirical verification of 45-minute complex whole-body tactical work capacity.

EXP-0036.negative_result: Direct transfer of local single-muscle parameters to the macroscopic D2 model is physically impermissible; TARGET-CPE45 cannot be validated from local imaging alone.
